text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I learned so much watching you two
train!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
The trust you both have in one another
is
especially amazing!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, sorry to hold you up when you must
be tired!
I'll see you later!
